verdict.rationale: Egnyte's pricing documentation says it supports simultaneous collaborative editing by multiple users through browser-based Microsoft 365 applications. That is a documented integration that delivers real-time in-browser co-editing, which the story explicitly allows. The evidence is a single feature-list line, so depth is thin. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that docs, sheets and slides (Word/Excel/PowerPoint) are each covered, in-depth integration or setup documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, documents are editable in place — real-time co-editing of docs/sheets/slides in the browser, native or via a documented integration

citations.quote: Simultaneous collaborative editing of documents by multiple users using desktop or browser-based Microsoft 365 applications.
